# Zordra Robotics

Zordra Robotics specializes in intelligent dispatch software for grid-scale battery storage systems. Their flagship product, FluxCore, automates battery dispatch decisions by analyzing real-time grid conditions, degradation patterns, and market prices. FluxCore’s proprietary algorithms optimize charge and discharge cycles to maximize both battery lifespan and revenue from energy arbitrage and ancillary services.

Zordra targets utility-scale renewable energy storage operators, independent power producers, and microgrid developers. Its software currently manages over 120MW of operating battery capacity across diverse geographies, including solar farms in the Southwest and wind storage projects in the Midwest.

Founded three years ago, Zordra Robotics has secured $22 million in Series B funding led by the Valen Energy Fund. The 35-person team blends expertise in power systems engineering, AI, and battery chemistry. Key competitors include VoltOps Analytics and GridPulse Technologies, each offering dispatch solutions with varying trade-offs in optimization depth and user experience.

Open risks include evolving interconnection queue delays that affect deployment timelines and uncertainties in long-term battery degradation models impacting forecast accuracy.
